prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is edit target, EXACT 1024x500 Cube Run Candy banner. Image 2 is REAL gameplay reference. Correct the vertically wrong position of every duck obstacle (horizontal beam with black downward chevrons). This is a geometrical translation, not a redesign. In image 1 nearest purple chevron beam currently runs approximately from x=476 to x=841 and y=92 to y=168. MOVE THAT ENTIRE BEAM DOWN by 130 pixels so its top is about y=222 and bottom about y=298. Do not leave ANY copy of beam at the old position. Reconstruct pink sky/scenery behind its old footprint. Shift the second pink beam from approximately y=160 to y=210 (50 pixels downward). Shift the third orange beam from about y=190 to y=219 (29 pixels downward). Shift remaining distant beams down correspondingly in perspective. This makes the beam tops LOWER than the tall cyan pillar tops, with small slide clearance above the road, as in gameplay. The nearest beam must visibly occupy the MIDDLE BAND of the image crossing the middle of the tall pillar, NOT the sky. Keep widths, thickness, color, black downward chevrons, perspective, and same x/z position. No poles or supports. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE UNCHANGED: title, cube pose and location, road, coins, low walls, tall pillars, sky colors and scenery. Preserve 1024:500 aspect ratio.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Remove ONLY the CUBE RUN lettering in image 1, including its outline and extrusion. Reconstruct candy scenery behind it. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE exactly unchanged, especially the corrected LOW chevron beams, their exact vertical locations, the cube, road, coins and obstacles. Absolutely no words or letters. Preserve wide aspect ratio.
